info.name: Elite Hub by Double D — API
info.description:
Complete REST API collection for the Elite Hub hotel management system.

**Base URL:** `{{baseUrl}}`

**Authentication:** Most endpoints require a Bearer token. Set the `token` variable after logging in via `POST /auth/login`.

**Variables to configure:**
- `baseUrl` — e.g. `http://localhost:3000/api`
- `token` — JWT token from login response

request.description: Authenticate a staff member. Returns a JWT token. Copy the token value into the `token` collection variable.
One-time setup endpoint to create the Super Admin account. No authentication required.
Register a new admin. Requires super_admin authentication. Limited to 4 admins total.

Register a new staff member. Requires admin or super_admin authentication.

Valid roles: `super_admin`, `admin`, `accountant`, `supervisor`, `manager`, `receptionist`, `housekeeping`, `restaurant_staff`, `bar_staff`, `waiter`, `kitchen_staff`, `maintenance`

Valid departments: `reception`, `housekeeping`, `maintenance`, `management`, `restaurant`
Get the authenticated staff member's profile.
Change the authenticated user's password. New password must differ from old and meet complexity requirements.
Request a password reset email. A reset link will be sent to the provided email address.
Reset password using the token received via email.

item.name: Reservations
item.description: Room reservation management. Public endpoints for guests, protected endpoints for staff.

request.description: Check which rooms are available for a given date range. No authentication required.
View available rooms grouped by room type. Designed for the public-facing booking page. No authentication required.
Submit a reservation request as a guest. No authentication required. Reservation starts with `pending` status and requires staff approval.

Create a reservation for an existing guest. Alternatively, pass a `guest` object instead of `guestId` to create a new guest inline.

Roles: `super_admin`, `admin`, `accountant`, `supervisor`, `manager`, `receptionist`

**With new guest inline:**
```json
{
  "guest": {
    "firstName": "Bob",
    "lastName": "Brown",
    "email": "bob@example.com",
    "phone": "+2348011223344",
    "address": "12 Main Street",
    "city": "Benin City",
    "country": "Nigeria",
    "idType": "national_id",
    "idNumber": "NIN12345678",
    "dateOfBirth": "1990-06-15"
  },
  "roomId": "uuid-or-room-number",
  "checkInDate": "2026-05-10",
  "checkOutDate": "2026-05-14",
  "numberOfGuests": 1
}
```
